AI.title: Photo analysis
AI.intro: Selected photos become suggestions. You decide individually which details to accept.
AI.usageNote: A started request counts once. Redelivery of the same request does not count again.

AI.unavailable: Photo analysis is currently unavailable. You can continue editing your item manually.
